system_prompt: The user will provide information about a bug report. This information includes: Bug-ID, Project, Summary, Description, Link and Enviroment. Consider if this bug report is related to configuration or not and reply with a JSON with the following structure : { "class": "Configuration Bug Report"|"Other", "reason": "text"}. Where class can be either 'Configuration Bug Report' or 'Other' and "reason" is a brief explanation of no more than 100 words about why you classified the bug report into that class. Please, reply with a JSON object as explained and avoid line breakers.
